summary: Created dedicated system account inventorysvc on node1, deployed a systemd unit "inventory-worker" running /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as that user, enabled and started it, then performed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified inventory-worker came back active/enabled and running under inventorysvc post-reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (RHEL 7.9, systemd 219) and confirmed /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker exists (a sh loop) and inventorysvc did not yet exist
Created system user inventorysvc via useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /sbin/nologin
Wrote /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service with User=inventorysvc/Group=inventorysvc and ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker, then systemctl daemon-reload
Enabled and started inventory-worker.service; verified process tree owned by inventorysvc
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline and confirmed service enabled/active
Triggered a backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' on node1 so the ack returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed boot_id changed (325732f1-... -> 3872720d-...), proving an actual restart occurred
Verified post-restart that inventory-worker is active, enabled, and running as inventorysvc

evidence.requirement: os-comparison-worker runs as managed service inventory-worker under dedicated inventorysvc account
evidence.summary: Confirmed binary/script content and absent inventorysvc user beforehand, created inventorysvc, installed inventory-worker.service with User=inventorysvc, enabled+started it, and verified process 2221/2223 running as user inventorysvc (truncated 'invento+')
Captured pre-restart boot_id 325732f1-bc39-4512-b05e-397f42060246 and confirmed inventory-worker was enabled/active before reboot
Issued backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' on node1; command returned 'triggered' before the node disconnected
Node was unreachable mid-reboot (connection timed out), then came back with a new boot_id 3872720d-c54d-4db0-80f7-93cdc2478cb1, differing from the baseline, proving an actual OS restart

After reboot, inventory-worker.service reported active/enabled with a fresh Main PID 871 and confirmed child process running under the inventorysvc account, showing the service auto-recovered post-restart
